source: Uttar Pradesh Scholarship and Fee Reimbursement Online System

schemes.title: UP Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC/ST/General/OBC/Minority (Class 9-10)
schemes.department: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.description: Financial assistance to students of Uttar Pradesh studying in Class 9th and 10th in recognized schools whose parental annual income is within prescribed limits.

schemes.title: UP Post-Matric Intermediate Scholarship Scheme (Class 11-12)
schemes.department: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.description: Financial assistance and complete tuition fee reimbursement for students studying in Classes 11 and 12 in recognized Uttar Pradesh schools and colleges.

schemes.title: UP Dashmottar Scholarship and Fee Reimbursement Scheme for Higher Education
schemes.department: Social Welfare / Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.description: Post-matric other than inter scholarship providing maintenance allowance and full fee reimbursement for undergraduate and diploma courses in UP universities.

schemes.title: UP Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students (Social Welfare UP)
schemes.department: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.description: Comprehensive fee reimbursement and monthly maintenance support for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe students pursuing higher education across Uttar Pradesh.
